items.headline: Stocks slip on Wall Street as rising Treasury yields pressure the market
items.summary: U.S. stocks declined as rising Treasury yields pressured valuations and investor sentiment, creating a headwind for growth and technology portfolios.

items.headline: Tech stocks steady as Anthropic IPO filing and Nvidia buyback draw attention
items.summary: U.S. stock futures edged higher as technology shares stabilized; Reuters reporting highlighted Anthropic’s IPO ambitions and Nvidia’s expanded $150 billion share-buyback authorization.

items.headline: AI-powered chip developer Arm falls sharply in broad technology selloff
items.summary: Arm was identified as a major Nasdaq decliner after a technology-sector selloff, while broader markets were also pressured by higher oil prices and Treasury yields.

items.headline: Meta expands Muse AI agent to small businesses
items.summary: Meta announced an expansion of its Muse consumer AI agent into the small-business market, potentially broadening the commercial use case for its AI products.
